headline: Pace Digitek wins Coal India's 187.5 MW / 750 MWh standalone battery project at Choutuppal, Telangana (₹1,074 crore, ₹3.14 lakh per MW a month, 11 bidders) and gets a BSES Rajdhani letter of intent for 57.5 MW / 115 MWh across four Delhi substations

Olectra's MD calls electric trucks a bigger opportunity than buses: its first trucks cover 28–55 tonne tippers and tractor-trailers, the Sitarampur plant is sized for about 1,200 trucks a year, and he says about 74% of state bus purchases in Q1 were electric

Nio keeps developing its own large cylindrical cells, with EVE and Gotion reportedly making them and only a tiny batch due by year-end, while it buys more CATL prismatic cells for its Onvo and Firefly brands
Polish utility PGE starts building a 400 MW battery at Gryfino near Szczecin, with Fluence supplying 94 Smartstack units of 10 MWh each; operation is planned for 2028

Tamil Nadu's regulator (TNERC) clears the state discom to buy 600 MW of solar plus 300 MW / 1.8 GWh of six-hour storage from SECI's ISTS Tranche XXI at ₹3.12/kWh for 25 years; storage must supply evening and night peaks (6 pm–9 am)
short: Tamil Nadu clears 600 MW solar with 1.8 GWh storage at ₹3.12/kWh

headline: Water-purifier maker KENT RO sets up Kent New Energy with a ₹250-crore Noida plant for home and commercial lithium storage packs (5.1–16 kWh) and hybrid inverters: 3.5 GWh a year at start, aiming for 10 GWh within about six months, using EVE and REPT cells
short: KENT RO enters lithium storage packs with a 3.5 GWh Noida plant

headline: Chinese storage maker Sigenergy plans a $150–200 million battery and inverter factory in India, shortlisting Maharashtra, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Tamil Nadu; it would start with imported cells and needs government approval as a Chinese investor (report citing the Times of India)
Blue Energy Motors and HPCL open a heavy e-truck battery-swap station at an HPCL outlet in Bhiwandi on the Mumbai–Pune electric freight corridor; a swap takes under five minutes

Samsung SDI signs a further 1 GWh deal with US power producer Alpha Omega Power for its Battery Box 1.7 NCA containers, all made at the StarPlus plant in Indiana, for delivery before end-2026; the buyer's total with SDI reaches 1.5 GWh

Svolt starts mass production of its 100 kWh 'Dragon Armor' semi-solid pack in Changzhou: 900 V, 6C charging, liquid cooling on top and bottom, over 3,000 cycles claimed, at a cost it says matches liquid-electrolyte packs

Ronbay invests about $540 million in a 200,000 t-a-year sodium-ion cathode plant in Xiangyang, Hubei, taking its planned sodium-ion cathode capacity to 500,000 t a year; construction is expected to take about a year

Giga Storage lines up €260 million of bank debt and a 380 kV grid connection for its 350 MW / 1.4 GWh battery near Neuenkirchen, Germany, with CATL supplying 264 containers; commissioning now slips to early 2029

Paradeep Parivahan signs a 10-year deal with JSW Cement and JSW Eco-Mobility to run 100 electric heavy trucks hauling about 125,000 t of clinker and slag a month from Nandyal (Andhra Pradesh) to Vijayanagar (Karnataka)

EVE Energy tells investors its fourth-quarter cell capacity is fully booked and output will rise on the quarter; inventory turnover is about 56 days and it will run leaner stock while raw-material prices swing
Haryana Power Purchase Centre (the state's two discoms) invites bids for solar projects with battery storage inside Haryana; bids are due 17 November (capacity not stated in the report)

CATL confirms the new 60 kWh pack in Nio's Firefly uses its Qilin battery with NCM cells (560 km CLTC range), while the original 42 kWh LFP pack comes from Sunwoda; both share the same casing and mounts, so existing cars can switch packs by battery swap

Business Today: India is planning a ₹12,000-crore PLI for cell materials (cathode and anode active materials, electrolyte, separators, foil); under the existing ₹18,100-crore ACC PLI only Ola runs cell capacity (2.5 of its 20 GWh) and no maker has yet been paid an incentive, while cell imports keep climbing
short: India plans a ₹12,000-crore PLI for cell materials

headline: Bondada Engineering accepts GIPCL's letter of intent for a 20 MW / 120 MWh vanadium redox flow battery at Vadodara, Gujarat, with 10 years of O&M; billed as India's largest grid-scale flow battery, due within 18 months of award

Chemvolt Global proposes a ₹2,500-crore, two-phase lithium-ion cell plant at Ratlam, Madhya Pradesh (land allotment under way); it also signs an MoU with China's HyperStrong for large storage projects in the Middle East
Australia's resources department forecasts spodumene averaging about US$2,499/t in FY2027, up 63% from about US$1,532/t in FY2026, before easing to about US$1,684/t by FY2031

CATL Europe's Akin Li: its standard swappable packs (#20, #25, #26 for cars, 75# for heavy trucks) fit about 85% of China's A-segment models; truck swaps take about 5 minutes vs about 25 at a charger, and its three European plants will exceed 150 GWh
Volkswagen Anhui launches the Xpeng-co-developed ID. UNYX 09 sedan from about $25,290 (limited offer) with a standard 92 kWh CATL 5C pack (250 km added in 5 minutes, up to 755 km CLTC)
Adani Green switches on another 3.08 GWh of battery storage at Khavda in July–September, taking the site to about 6.6 GWh, which it says is more than half of India's operating BESS capacity

Ember: a PM Surya Ghar battery subsidy for half the rooftop scheme's target could add 15–25 GWh of home storage for about ₹28,000 crore; a 50% subsidy would cut solar-plus-battery payback from over 9 years to under 7

BloombergNEF raises its 2026 forecast: global storage additions to jump 45% to about 188 GW / 535 GWh (from 158 GW / 459 GWh expected in mid-year), with India adding more than 6 GW this year and 638 GWh worldwide in 2027

Benchmark Mineral Intelligence expects lithium demand from stationary storage to slow from more than 60% a year to about 5% a year through 2030; total lithium demand seen rising from 2.1 million t LCE in 2026 to about 7 million t by 2050

German home-battery maker sonnen files for insolvency two months after Shell sold it; about 400 staff affected, revenue had fallen from €443 million (2023) to about €199 million (2024); customer service continues and one production site stays

Hithium enters Canada with a 4 MWh sodium-ion storage system for very cold sites (2–8 hour duration), alongside a 6.25 MWh container built on its 1,175 Ah cell and a 6.9 MWh 8-hour system using 1,300 Ah cells

Ultraviolette launches its 100 V VX-100 modular platform with the X-47 Venom e-motorcycle (₹2.65 lakh introductory); its new SRB-11 pack claims up to 20% higher energy density and twice the cooling, with IP67 sealing, pyro-fuse, cell-level fuses and BMS

BYD's Denza opens pre-sales of the refreshed N8 SUV on 26 Oct with the second-generation Blade battery and flash charging: about 5 minutes for a usable charge and 9 minutes to near-full, 3 minutes more at −30°C

Lithium carbonate futures in Guangzhou bounce 2.9% to about $14,520/t on 23 Oct after this week's slide; China spot still slips to about $14,480/t, and SMM puts LFP cathode down 1.5% on the week at about $6,550/t
ACME Solar signs an FDRE (firm, dispatchable renewables) power deal with SECI for 300 MW of solar with 1.2 GWh of co-located batteries (4 hours of supply after sunset) at about $0.063/kWh
short: ACME wins SECI deal: 300 MW solar with 1.2 GWh of batteries

headline: NASH Energy shows its made-in-India NE32140 LFP cell, two-wheeler, e-rickshaw and telecom packs, in-house BMS and 261–500 kWh BESS units at The Battery Show India

Nio's Firefly launches its 60 kWh ternary (NMC) pack beside the 42 kWh LFP pack: same size, weight and mounting, so existing owners can switch by battery swap; CLTC range rises to 560 km and the upgrade costs owners about $2,530

US sodium-ion storage maker Peak Energy raises $108 million led by GM Ventures; it plans a 4 GWh-a-year plant in Sacramento from early 2027 and claims over $1 billion of orders, starting with data centres

China's lead-acid leaders push sodium-ion into two- and three-wheelers: Tianneng launches 24–72 Ah sodium-ion packs (one keeps about 90% capacity at −30 °C); sodium-ion cells are exempt from China's new 2% battery tax until end-2028
CPCA expects China's October NEV retail sales to be about 1.07 million, down 16.5% on a year and 1.3% on September, as the usual autumn peak fades; NEV share stays near 67%
Rwanda tenders a 200 MW floating solar plant with an 800 MWh battery on Lake Sake under an IPP model; pre-qualification bids are due on 12 November
Lithium carbonate futures in Guangzhou fall 3.6% to about $14,060/t on 22 Oct, below the $15,000 level; China spot drops to about $14,830/t

Mercom: India's battery-storage manufacturing capacity reaches about 86 GWh, but 92% is pack/container assembly and only 8% is cell making; most capacity is still under construction, mainly in Gujarat and Maharashtra

GM's fourth-generation EV platform will use prismatic lithium manganese-rich (LMR) cells from its LG Energy Solution joint venture in Tennessee, aiming for 33% more energy density than LFP at similar cost

Gujarat's power regulator (GERC) notifies its first grid-interactive battery-storage regulations, covering planning, procurement, operation and scheduling of BESS; standalone storage may not serve captive or third-party renewable plants
India's transmission utility CTUIL sets a minimum storage duration for BESS grid-connectivity applications: four hours for specified applications, two hours for eligible right-of-first-refusal cases

BAIC signs a wider battery-swap deal with CATL: compatible models from several BAIC brands will join CATL's Choco-swap network, with swap stations built at BAIC dealerships (CATL had about 2,520 stations at end-September)
Switch Mobility delivers the first six of 50 EiV12 electric intercity coaches to Pune-based Purple Bus for the Nagpur–Chandrapur route (claimed range up to 350 km)
BW ESS secures debt financing from OCBC, Rabobank and Societe Generale for its Hams Hall BESS in the UK (350 MW/1,243 MWh in phase 1, rising to 400 MW/1,424 MWh)
InfoLink weekly: lithium carbonate down 6.4% to about $15,220/t; 314 Ah storage cells slip 0.6% to $47.3/kWh; 4-hour AC system prices unchanged at $70.0/kWh
Tesla Q3: 13.7 GWh of storage deployed (below analyst hopes of about 15.9 GWh); energy revenue falls 16% to $2.88 billion but energy gross margin rises to 33%
Hoymiles launches the HoyUltra 2000M liquid-cooled C&I storage cabinet line (2–2.61 MWh, 500 kW–1.25 MW) built on 314 Ah LFP cells

CATL shares drop more than 10% after Q3: profit up 14.5% but margin slips to 20.7% as China's new 2% battery consumption tax and the end of export VAT rebates (1 Jan 2027) bite; JPMorgan downgrades the Hong Kong shares
Lopal unit signs a 2026–2030 deal to supply about 379,000–568,000 t of LFP cathode; SMM puts mid-October NEV-grade LFP at about $7,090/t, roughly 60% above the June 2025 low
EVE Energy rolls out new solid-state cells (a 1,045 Wh/L button cell for medical devices, plus polymer-oxide and semi-solid types) and a sodium-ion battery for electric two-wheelers
Bloomberg: GM leads a $108 million funding round for a sodium-ion battery start-up (headline only, not verified)
Huawei's car unit joins CATL's Choco-swap battery network; GAC-Huawei brand Aistaland is reported to be first with swappable-pack models (unconfirmed); CATL runs 2,520 swap stations
Tata Power's strategy head says Indian standalone BESS tariffs have fallen more than 80% since 2022, against about 40% for packs; analysts see up to three-quarters of awarded 2-hour capacity at risk
QuantumScape plans a 100 MWh solid-state cell production line aimed at AI data centres, aerospace and defence, with equipment from Muehlbauer; production targeted for 2028

Li Auto shows its in-house 'Lianshan' battery (made with a Sunwoda joint venture): 5C cells, a pack that stays fire-free 24 hours after one cell fails, and a guarantee of at least 75% health for 8 years
BYD launches the second-generation Seagull from about $9,810 with 30–39 kWh batteries and 5-minute 10–70% flash charging on upper trims
EU publishes a draft act on who may access battery passport data; digital passports become mandatory for large batteries from February 2027
China lithium spot edges down to about $15,280/t as buyers wait for lower prices
CATL launches a swappable 'dual-electric' battery system for heavy trucks (432–513 kWh main pack plus 77 kWh backup) and targets 900 swap stations by end-2026
CATL's third-quarter profit misses estimates as competition and outlook concerns weigh (headline only, not verified)
Vikram Solar unit VSL PowerHive plans a 7.5 GWh/yr BESS assembly plant near Chennai (scalable to 15 GWh), operating from April 2027, with 7.5 GWh of cell making planned from 2028
Trontek will unveil a 5 MWh EKOM containerised storage system at The Battery Show India; the company has 3 GWh of capacity and plans 12 GWh by 2028
sources: The Machine Maker · pv magazine India

headline: Saft (TotalEnergies) opens France's first solid-state battery lines in Bordeaux for aviation and space, claiming up to 50% higher energy density; Safran tests start next year
BYD Energy Storage expands its global after-sales network to nine service centres; says it shipped over 60 GWh of storage systems in 2025, the most worldwide
Lithium futures dip below $14,900, then close up 1.5% at $15,010
MAHAGENCO tenders 500 MW / 1.6 GWh of battery storage, build-own-operate; bids due 5 Nov

Varroc to buy 45% of Forsee Power India and take control, starting with battery packs for electric three-wheelers; Energy In Motion opens a 5,000-a-year electric heavy-truck plant with pack lines in Pune
Varroc Engineering to take a 45% stake and management control of Forsee Power India, which makes EV battery packs; it starts with three-wheelers and plans to add buses, trucks and industrial uses
Nio's Firefly small car gets a 60 kWh CATL pack option (up from 42.1 kWh LFP) for 560 km CLTC range, open to existing owners as an upgrade; details on 23 Oct
CNNC awards a 2.98 GWh storage framework at about $66–70/kWh; Sungrow and CATL among five winners
China September storage awards: 4-hour systems down 12% to about $70/kWh
Gotion begins commissioning its LFP cell plant in Kenitra, Morocco (first phase about $1.3 billion, up to 20 GWh a year planned) to supply Africa, Europe, the Middle East and the US
DALY BMS will show battery management systems for electric two- and three-wheelers and home storage at The Battery Show India, Greater Noida, 22–24 Oct
China's September EV battery installations reach 87.2 GWh, 85.5% LFP; CATL 40.9%, BYD 21.1%, CALB 7.0% share
Bloomberg: lithium extends its slump as battery demand worries mount; down about 14% on the week
CRISIL expects electric buses to reach about 17% of new bus registrations in India next fiscal year, up from 7% in FY26; public orders total about 29,000 e-buses
China will cut the export VAT rebate on EVs, e-buses and electric truck tractors from 13% to 9% from 1 April 2027; the separate battery export rebate (now 6%) is still due to end on 1 January 2027
China's total NEV sales rise 13.6% to 1.82 million in September as exports jump 160% to 571,000 vehicles

Tata Motors (commercial vehicles) Q2: wholesale volumes up 42% to about 135,100, revenue up 36% and back in profit; exports up 177%. Its Iveco takeover offer closes 26 Oct, with settlement planned for 30 Oct
Andhra Pradesh (APPCC) tenders 1,250 MW / 5 GWh of standalone battery storage at three sites, build-own-operate; bids due 23 Nov
short: Andhra Pradesh tenders 5 GWh of standalone battery storage

headline: Telangana (TGREDCO) tenders 3 GW of solar with 1 GW / 6 GWh of energy storage, bids due 4 Nov; TGGENCO's 187.5 MW / 750 MWh Maheswaram storage tender closed 19 Oct
short: Telangana tenders 3 GW of solar with 6 GWh of storage

headline: NTPC Green tenders a turnkey EPC contract for 3.3 GWh of battery storage at its Khavda solar park in Gujarat (three 300 MW/900 MWh blocks and one 200 MW/600 MWh), with 15 years of O&M
short: NTPC Green tenders 3.3 GWh of battery storage at Khavda

headline: GreenCell Mobility raises equity from Impact Fund Denmark to grow its electric bus fleet to more than 5,000 buses across 105 Indian cities (about 4,500 now being rolled out)

Korean battery makers diverge in Q3: LG Energy Solution posts record revenue (+59%) and operating profit (+26%) on North American storage; Samsung SDI expected back in profit, SK On still loss-making (final results 29 Oct)
China's storage chain recovers: EVE Energy forecasts nine-month profit up 80–90% on revenue up about 60%; Ganfeng Lithium's nine-month revenue rises 147%; inverter maker Deye's profit rises about 80%

France and Germany agree a common EU car position: drop the 2035 climate-neutral target, ease plug-in hybrid rules and limit subsidies to cars made in the EU, UK and EEA; T&E warns EU EV share could fall to 43% by 2030, putting 254 GWh of battery capacity at risk
CATL and SERES (AITO) sign a long-term deal: a second Chongqing plant phase adds 10–12 GWh a year (over 20 GWh in total), and they will go after Europe, the Middle East and Central Asia together
EnergyX and Trafigura sign a 10-year take-or-pay offtake for 100,000 t of battery-grade lithium from Chile (carbonate) and Texas (hydroxide), worth over $2 billion at about $20,000/t
